purpose: Factor the local v8.5.2 current amplitude exactly, identify the optimal rank-one character decomposition, derive a global 5m-sign full-support linear kernel, and prove that this dual kernel returns bijectively (up to one global F3 shift per connected component) to the original 12-state quotient. This removes a representation loop without promoting it as a polynomial solver.

two_linear_factor_theorem.name: C4_CURRENT_TWO_LINEAR_FACTOR_IDENTITY
two_linear_factor_theorem.statement: For every k in F3^6, h(k.VP)+h(k.VM)=h(k.a)h(k.b). Therefore F6(k)=delta[sum_i k_i=0] h(k.a)h(k.b).
two_linear_factor_theorem.proof: Write h(t)=omega^t+omega^{-t}. Since VP=a+b and VM=a-b, h(x+y)+h(x-y)=(omega^x+omega^{-x})(omega^y+omega^{-y})=h(x)h(y).

optimal_cp_rank_theorem.name: CP_RANK_F6_EQUALS_12
optimal_cp_rank_theorem.upper_bound: Using delta[1.k=0]=(1/3) sum_{c in F3} omega^{c 1.k} and h(t)=sum_{eps in {+1,-1}} omega^{eps t}, F6=(1/3) sum_{c,alpha,beta} omega^{(c*1+alpha*a+beta*b).k}. This is a 12-term rank-one character decomposition.
optimal_cp_rank_theorem.wire_state_identity: The 12 exponent vectors c*1+alpha*a+beta*b are exactly the twelve quotient wire states c*1+s*v_q under alpha=s, beta=s*q.
optimal_cp_rank_theorem.lower_bound: A 3|3 flattening of F6 has exact matrix rank 12. Every CP decomposition needs at least the rank of every flattening, so CP-rank(F6)>=12.
optimal_cp_rank_theorem.conclusion: CP-rank(F6)=12 and the canonical quotient-state character decomposition is rank-optimal.

global_full_support_kernel.setting: A closed loopless network of m six-port wires whose 6m ports are paired into E=3m oriented splice edges. Let B in F3^{m x E} be the signed incidence matrix and K=ker(B).
global_full_support_kernel.row_system: Define R in F3^{(E+2m) x E}: E coordinate rows for the edge factors h(k_e), plus two rows r_{v,a},r_{v,b} per wire obtained by inserting signed a- and b-port coefficients on incident edges.
global_full_support_kernel.identity: Let N=#{s in {+1,-1}^{E+2m}: R^T s belongs to row(B)}. Then Z=3^{-2m}*3^{E-rank(B)}*N = 3^{m-rank(B)} N.
global_full_support_kernel.connected_components: For an incidence matrix with c connected components, rank(B)=m-c, so Z=3^c N.
global_full_support_kernel.proof: Expand every scalar h(r.k) as sum_{eps=+/-1} omega^{eps r.k}. Character orthogonality over K gives sum_{k in K} omega^{y.k}=|K| iff y lies in K^perp=row(B), otherwise zero.

dual_return_bijection.sign_split: Write s=(gamma_e for edges, alpha_v,beta_v for wires). Membership R^T s=B^T lambda introduces one F3 potential lambda_v per wire, unique up to one additive constant on each connected component.
dual_return_bijection.port_colours: For a fixed incidence convention define C_{v,p}=lambda_v-alpha_v*a_p-beta_v*b_p. Because (-alpha_v,-beta_v) range over {+/-1}^2, every six-port vector C_v is exactly one canonical quotient wire state c*1+s*v_q, and every quotient wire state occurs uniquely for a fixed lambda_v.
dual_return_bijection.edge_constraint: The membership equation on an oriented splice edge rearranges to gamma_e=C_tail-C_head. Since gamma_e is restricted to {+1,-1}, this is exactly the exposed-port NEQ constraint.
dual_return_bijection.multiplicity: Each sign solution has exactly 3^c choices of componentwise additive lambda constants, matching Z=3^c N. Hence the full-support kernel is not a strictly smaller decision problem: it is an exact dual coordinate presentation of the same quotient CSP.
dual_return_bijection.anti_loop: The 5m-sign kernel is useful as a normal form, but counting/deciding its full-support solutions cannot be declared polynomial merely because its linear equations are compact. v5.2/v5.6 already firewall generic nowhere-zero/full-support and syndrome-kernel reasoning.

two_wire_exhaustive_control.method: For every permutation matching six ports of wire 0 to six ports of wire 1, compare direct enumeration of 12^2 quotient states with N over all 2^10 sign assignments. The two-wire incidence rank is one, so Z=3N.

positive: The local +/- transition sum factors into two scalar h factors; no 3-state/24-state local transition expansion is mathematically necessary.
The local CP rank is exactly known and the 12 quotient character terms are optimal among rank-one tensor decompositions.
The global current contraction has an exact polynomial-size linear-algebraic full-support presentation with 5m binary sign variables.
anti_loop: The full-support presentation is exactly dual to the original 12-state quotient after introducing lambda potentials; it does not by itself reduce decision complexity.
Do not revisit generic linear hashing/critical-problem compression without a source-specific theorem.
algorithmic_consequence.remaining_constructive_target: Exploit Hamiltonian occurrence order globally in a representation that is not equivalent to merely re-encoding the same 12-state CSP.

next_target.name: E8_C4_HAMILTONIAN_ORDER_TRANSFER_COMMUNICATION_RANK_V8_5_9
next_target.directive: Build the exact Hamiltonian-order transfer/communication matrix for smooth fixed-C4 sources. Determine whether its boundary algebra admits polynomial rank compression. First derive basis-independent cut ranks on explicit source-realizable families; if ranks grow exponentially, freeze that transfer class and move to a genuinely nonlocal contraction. If a polynomial closure appears, prove update closure, bitlength, nonzero decision and witness reconstruction.
next_target.external_control: Mujuni (2008) gives FPT algorithms parameterized by the number of inner cycles, so an exponential-in-inner-cycles transfer is not a universal polynomial advance.
